records.title: A stack of newspapers in the morning light
records.not_captured: the freshness of the early morning air and the damp smell of fresh morning newsprint

records.title: Horse racing tips between magazines.
records.not_captured: Atmosphere of anxiety and heated discussions when countless horse fans gathered in front of the newsstand

records.title: The high-pitched sound of coins hitting together
records.not_captured: The warmth of palms when changing coins

records.title: Yellow light lit in the evening
records.not_captured: A buzzing sound from an old light tube inside a light box

records.title: Tearing off a page of newspaper
records.not_captured: The resistance at the moment of tearing, and the eagerness of readersto read that news.

records.title: A water bottle of newspaper stall owner to weigh down the newspapers
records.not_captured: The evaporation speed of water droplets in the bottle under the sun, and the aging smell of plastic that has been heated for a long time.

records.title: Flipping newspaper
records.not_captured: The musty smell of old newspaper due to dryness between the pages

records.title: Torn canvas tent to keep out the rain
records.not_captured: The echo of raindrops on the tarp

records.title: Advertisements plastered all over the walls of newsstand
records.not_captured: The hardened texture of paper after the glue has dried

records.title: Glass Coke bottles clinking together
records.not_captured: The cool air of the ice bucket holding drinks

records.title: 檔主用原子筆在帳簿上畫的記號
records.not_captured: 手部關節因長期勞損而產生的酸痛，以及那本破舊帳簿記錄的微薄利潤。

records.title: 傍晚收攤時拍打紙堆的灰塵聲
records.not_captured: 空氣中揚起肉眼看不見的微細粉粒與舊紙屑吸入鼻腔時的真實窒息感。

records.title: 晨早買報人與檔主默契的打招呼聲
records.not_captured: 那種數十年老街坊之間無需言語的深厚社區連結與人情味。

records.title: 太陽直射下泛黃變脆的副刊封面
records.not_captured: 紫外線對紙張化學結構產生的無情破壞，以及顏色一點一滴褪色的寂靜過程。

records.title: 翻閱時沾上指頭的黑色油墨粉粒
records.place: 深水埗長沙灣道報紙檔
records.not_captured: 印刷油墨沾在皮膚上的真實觸感，以及擦拭不掉的物理殘留痕跡。
